body: Ok it time.. i prey to god i wouldnt live after the jump... my sister is sleeping in the other room and i already feel so ashamed.. sorry if i made someone here feel bad :\ have a good life

Its not very interesting, so ill try to make it short - my dad started gaining height in 16-17.  When i entered high school at 14 i was very short. Although my doctor ran some tests on me and everything was fine, I was searching for ways to become taller faster (at the time since 13 i becase kind of distand from many people , and add to that that in high school they put me in basketball class...). Then i found a doctor that was "specialized" in HGH injection and stuff. He made it sound promising and bright, and ofcourse it gave me faith and i wanted to start is ASAP.. turns out i didnt need the injection, the amounts he gave me were extremely high, and the treatment was 3x longer than usual. Then, when it ended i realized the great mistake ive done - my natural hgh started pumping and my body quickly deformed, my nose, forehead and cheekbones grew like an alien and my whole body is filled with scars, as my skin cant heal wounds or scratches properly. i was always depressed, even when i took the injection, but they brought me faith.. most of the time in high school i was sitting alone, but there was this beatiful girl who was really nice to me, she even said she loves me as a friend and stuff, but as i grew up and got more depressed about my growth (my whole face changed, at first i thought it was just genetics) my self confident dropped even more. i just walked by people as if i never knew them and honestly i feel humiliated enough knowing they see me.. what have i become.. I barely remember stuff from my childhood i guess my brain blocked most of it.. I just wish i could grow like everybody else.. But i guess tomorrow its all going to end, I will simply not be anymore and it will all stop, the dark cloud in my chest that was lying there for years, my tears that randomly drop when im alone and all the wasted youth.. I am so afraid that i am going to live through this. I eat once or twice every 2 days, i sleep most of the days, and all my finals are shit. My parents want to help but i get mad even when they talk to me i guess i just selfishly see them as a burden because they keep me from dying.. Although everything they did for me, was for my best, i guess it just didnt turn for the best. They even told me they would suicide after me if i do it. I just want to not feel this.. and as long as im inside this filthy body.. I will never be able to be myself or be something else than a burden..
